name: glossary-lookup
description: Context-aware domain glossary lookup skill that extracts and provides verified terminology translations for specialized settings (medical, emergency/disaster relief, legal). Adheres to the Agent Skills open standard.
author: MOSS Hack Day Team

context.description: User-specified scenario or domain, e.g., 'Emergency medical diagnosis' or 'Disaster relief rations distribution'.

source_text.description: The raw input speech/text from the speaker.

target_language.description: Target language code or name, e.g., 'kn' (Kannada), 'hi' (Hindi), 'te' (Telugu), 'ta' (Tamil), 'es' (Spanish).

matched_domain.description: Identified domain (medical, disaster_relief, legal, or general).

glossary_terms.description: Key-value dictionary mapping specialized source terms to verified target translations.

system_instruction_prompt.description: Formatted domain instructions to be injected into the LLM system prompt.
